name: Bellflower Tiller Dedication

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You have dedicated yourself to guiding others to liberty and safety. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. Choose up to six other people to be your "crop." You can add or remove someone from your crop by spending 10 minutes in conversation with them. Members of your crop can use your Speed for overland travel if it is higher than their own. A member of your crop benefits from this and other Bellflower tiller feats as long as they are within 60 feet of you.

Bellflower Tiller
